verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago publishes a developer API reference with Postman support (docs-28). Its documented APIs include the Checkout API, usable from web or mobile with the same API (docs-8, docs-11), Point POS APIs (docs-6), and webhook/IPN notifications (docs-18). A single token lets you programmatically operate payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores and reports (docs-27), and an independent HN thread confirms developers use the public API (comm-1). missing for 10: endpoint-level reference detail in the evidence (auth scheme, rate limits, full resource coverage), hands-on corroboration of current API usability
